solutions.explanation:
First, the denominators require \(x\ne1\) and \(x\ne2\). For every other real value, we may multiply both sides by the nonzero product \((x-1)(x-2)\). This gives
\[
x-2=2(x-1)=2x-2,
\]
so \(x=0\).

This value is allowed, and substitution into the original equation gives
\[
\frac1{0-1}=-1=\frac2{0-2}.
\]
All the transformations were reversible on the allowed domain, so there are no other solutions. Thus only \(\boxed{x=0}\) satisfies the equality, choice \(\text{E}\).
solutions.title: Exclude zero denominators and solve
